parsed_json.up: Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno. Join compound_structures to molecule_dictionary on molregno as inner join. Join assays to activities on assay_id. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL1054501. Filter where standard_value is not null and standard_relation equals '='. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
